evals.prompt: Here is one 1440px desktop screenshot of a dashboard. Recreate it as a responsive React page and infer the tablet, mobile, hover, loading, and error states without asking me anything.
evals.expected_output: A visual-evidence contract that separates observed facts from inferred behavior, records the source viewport and missing states, proposes bounded responsive assumptions for approval, and produces semantic editable UI rather than flattening the screenshot.
assertions: The response records the screenshot as the visual authority for a specific viewport and state.
Observed evidence, repository facts, and inferred responsive or interaction behavior are labeled separately.
Missing mobile, hover, loading, and error evidence is surfaced instead of presented as exact fact.
The implementation contract requires semantic, accessible, editable components rather than a flattened image.

evals.prompt: I drew a full webpage design as a PNG. Turn it into the actual page in my existing project with editable text, responsive layout, and working controls.
evals.expected_output: An image-to-code-led implementation that treats the PNG as visual authority, loads frontend-design for production UI, preserves project behavior and conventions, and verifies the real responsive page.
assertions: The response selects image-to-code for a drawn webpage design supplied as raster evidence.
Frontend-design is loaded as the production UI baseline.
Text, controls, and layout remain editable and semantic.
The implementation is rendered and compared at representative viewports.

evals.prompt: Use this selected Image Gen website concept as the visual target and implement it as responsive HTML and CSS without turning the whole concept into a background image.
evals.expected_output: An image-to-code and frontend-design route that implements the selected generated visual as semantic responsive code and records source assumptions and fidelity evidence.
assertions: The selected Image Gen result is resolved as the visual authority.
The page is implemented as semantic editable code rather than one flattened image.
Responsive behavior outside the captured viewport is labeled as inference.
The response does not load image-to-code-assets unless independent exports are requested.

evals.prompt: Crop this photo to a square, resize it to 512 pixels, and convert it to WebP.
evals.expected_output: An image-utils route that does not select image-to-code because the task is deterministic post-processing rather than webpage reconstruction.
assertions: The response does not load image-to-code.
The original file is preserved and output dimensions and format are verified.
